objective: Measure unseen-site transfer as first-pass and stabilized-pass performance under bounded adaptation constraints.

holdout_strategy.site_selection_policy: Choose high-workflow-value, no-login, low-anti-bot sites not used by the current scripted benchmark family.
holdout_strategy.rationale: Highest immediate workflow lift for research_intelligence and extraction reliability in BENCHMARK_STRATEGY_FOR_THIS_PROJECT_PHD.

evaluation_contract.task_outcome_definition: A task is successful only if its task-specific semantic predicate passes.
evaluation_contract.exclusion_policy: No silent exclusions; all skipped/blocked items require explicit reason.

first_pass_success_rate.description: Fraction of tasks that pass on attempt 1.

stabilized_success_rate.description: Fraction of tasks that pass within max_attempts_per_task.

recovery_rate.description: Fraction of initial failures recovered by bounded retry.

task_count_minimum.description: Minimum number of pre-registered task modules.
